description: Use this when the person has a specific upcoming meeting or call and wants to be ready for it. Writes the talk track, discovery questions for this buyer, the concerns this buyer is likely to raise and what they need to hear, and the one thing to get done in the meeting. Send the company name; Andru checks the person's calendar. This is the default for "prepare me for my call". Only if the person asks to talk with or play the buyers, use simulate_buyer_persona. Paid. Check the price with quote before running.

briefType.description: Type of meeting brief to generate (default: general)

companyName.description: Company you're meeting with. Andru finds the matching calendar event and pulls attendee context automatically.

contactName.description: Name of the person you're meeting (optional — helps match the right event and personalize the brief).

dealId.description: Associated deal ID for additional deal intelligence

eventId.description: Calendar event ID (from Andru calendar integration). If provided, skips calendar search.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional: any unique string for this call. Retrying with the same key returns the first result and never charges twice.

maxAmountCents.description: Optional: the most this call may cost, in cents. If the price is higher, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

quoteId.description: Optional: the quote_id from quote, to pay the quoted price (held for 30 minutes).

name: get_pre_brief
title: Prepare for a meeting
